content.short: DeFi Protection covers smart contract risks, alerts to threats, and reimburses losses.
content.description: Smart contract hacks remain a serious and recurring risk in DeFi, underscoring the need to safeguard assets against malicious attacks. DeFi Protection is a security product designed to evaluate smart contract safety, detect and flag potential vulnerabilities, and alert users when threats are identified. In the event of a hack, it offers reimbursement to DeFi users for their losses. This solution aims to help developers and users by continuously assessing contract risk and providing actionable safeguards.
content.meta: DeFi Protection checks smart contracts, alerts to threats, and reimburses users' losses. Discover DeFi Protection and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What DeFi Cover Actually Pays Out For
resources.tldr: Premiums fund a shared pool, and a claim only pays when a covered event is confirmed. The gap between that and insurance is the whole subject.

resources.title: Protocol Cover Explained
resources.tldr: Cover scoped to one protocol rather than a wallet, and the exploit types that fall inside and outside that boundary.
